# tools: add bin, effortless binary manager

Try [bin](https://github.com/marcosnils/bin), which installs and updates single-binary GitHub releases (`bin install github.com/owner/repo`) without a package manager. **Motivation:** "inspiration for [egg](https://github.com/kamilsk/egg)" — the author's own tool that generates the `tools.go` toolset, i.e. the interest is in the approach as much as in the tool.
